newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Woman rents house but complains about corpse.
newsitem.headline: Woman rents house but complains about corpse.

text.p: An Argentine woman who rented a house had to call police to remove a three-year old decomposed corpse, police said on Wednesday.

Apart from the corpse, Olga del Valle Vera found signs that someone else had been living in the house, including fresh fruit and vegetables and a recently made bed, the private DyN news agency reported.
Police in the northern town of San Salvador de Jujuy said they believed the corpse was the remains of Simon Canchi, who apparently died in 1993 aged 80.
Before moving in, Del Valle Vera paid five months rent in advance to two woman and was given a receipt signed with the name of Canchi's wife, who police said died in 1988.
